title: Create: Common Recipes
description: This mod just mainly adds recipes I've seen in youtuber's videos that are most common for factories and etc.
body:
# Create: Common Recipes

Create Common Recipes sets to add recipes i think should be in create mod. But it only has 1 recipe. This mod has a potentonal to add multiple new recipes, so request a recipe at the [Google Form](https://forms.gle/SPBn4Qh5e5zj77M68). The recipes this mod adds is Cobblestone ->> Netherrack through smoking process. That's one example of what recipes can be added. Check the Gallery for the recipes. This mod just mainly adds recipes I've seen in youtubers videos that are most common for factories and etc.

# This project is open source!
Find it [right here!](https://github.com/Cabbage698/Create-Common-Recipes)
and feel free to make your own version of this mod. Just make sure to credit me please. :)


# Read this if you want credits in the mod itself

By sumbiting to this google form you agree for your name to be credited in the gallery of what recipes you made. you can request to be in the mods credits as a "Suggestor" for recipes that you requested and you added. To request please forward a email to cabbage.contac@proton.me. It make take multiple days for this request to reach me.
